transactions.desc: The Angels released Manoah on Wednesday.
The Brewers optioned Stallings to Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday.
The Brewers selected Pannone's contract from Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Blue Jays recalled Dallas from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Van Eyk to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Nationals reinstated Williams (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Pirates optioned Mattson to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Kevin Gorman of TribLive.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Eisert to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates recalled Barco from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Callihan to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Pirates recalled Murdock from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday.
The Pirates recalled Garcia from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Mets recalled Pintaro from Triple-A Syracuse on Wednesday.
The Padres will promote Salas from Double-A San Antonio to Triple-A El Paso on Wednesday, Jeff Sanders of The San Diego Union-Tribune reports.
Atlanta activated Smith-Shawver (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Nationals optioned Varland to Triple-A Rochester following Tuesday's game against the Blue Jays.
Hernandez (oblique) was activated from the 10-day injured list Tuesday, Kirsten Watson of Spectrum SportsNet LA reports.
The Dodgers optioned Freeland to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Katie Woo of The Athletic reports.
The Giants selected Basabe's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday.
The Cardinals optioned Dobbins to Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Cardinals selected Strzelecki's contract from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Red Sox recalled Sogard from Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday, Ari Alexander of 7 News Boston reports.
Shewmake rejected an outright assignment to Triple-A Nashville and elected free agency Tuesday, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Mariners designated Kennedy for assignment Tuesday.
The Mariners reinstated Refsnyder (knee) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Guardians recalled Espino from Triple-A Columbus on Tuesday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Royals recalled McGee from Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
Atlanta re-signed Hernandez to a one-year contract Tuesday.
Atlanta optioned Thomas to Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
The Phillies optioned Henry to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
